interpretation: Finite 180-second solver-budget evidence only. Results include every planned run, including errors, timeouts, partial phases, and checkpoint recoveries. No extrapolation to the predeclared publication budget is made.

prefix_diversity.alias_handling: Checkpoint aliases such as laneN.pkl and laneN_PHASE.pkl are collapsed by lane, phase, and coordinate hash; conflicting hashes fail rendering.
prefix_diversity.interpretation: Exact coordinate-hash equality is reported only from checkpoint inventories embedded in finalized result metadata. Missing metadata does not prove that no physical checkpoint file was written; a timed-out worker may leave files that were not inventoried because result finalization did not finish. Different nominal lane seeds do not establish independent basin starts; effective initializer seeds are reported where recorded. Equality can motivate a future shared-prefix implementation, but no speedup is measured or claimed here.

resource_context.study_notes: Twelve-run readiness pilot; the 180-second solver budget is not the publication study budget.
